text: This report recommends that the name "Edward McIlwain Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane north of Davenport Road, extending between Regal Road and Oakwood Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Edward McIlwain Lane" for an existing public lane north of Davenport Road, extending between Regal Road and Oakwood Avenue.
